newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka banks rise sharply on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka banks rise sharply on growth prospects.

text.p: COLOMBO, Jun 25 (Reuter) _ Shares of Sri Lankan financial institutions rose after aggressive buying from retail and foreign investors, in early Wednesday trade, brokers said.
Hatton National Bank five to to 285, Lanka Orix Leasing 8.75 rupees to 253, National Development Bank five rupees to 260.
"Buying pressure is very strong among the banks since they are expected to see good profit growth in 1997," said Prasanna Chandrasekera of John Keells Stock Brokers.
